description: This file defines the SecurityAgent class within the WPEFramework plugin namespace. It declares the class's interfaces, nested classes, and methods related to security, authentication, token management, and access control. It also includes class definitions for TokenDispatcher, Config, Payload, and DirectoryCallback, along with relevant includes and interface mappings.

classes.name: SecurityAgent
classes.description: Main class implementing security and authentication interfaces for the plugin, managing tokens, access control, and communication.

classes.name: TokenDispatcher
classes.description: Handles communication with external components, managing references to the IAuthenticate interface.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: JSON container for configuration parameters such as ACL, connector, and DAC strings.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: JSON container representing the payload with a token type enumeration.

classes.name: DirectoryCallback
classes.description: Callback class for monitoring directory changes and loading access control lists from files.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates an authentication token based on input buffer.

methods.name: Officer
methods.description: Returns the security interface associated with a given token.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Processes incoming web requests, attaching deserializable data if present.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Handles the request processing on a thread pool thread, returning a response.

methods.name: endpoint_createtoken
methods.description: Creates a token in testing mode (conditional compilation).
